purpose: all available model candidates under synthetic pre-match odds stress scenarios

candidate_inventory.main_script: Current production Mode B LightGBM artifacts; synthetic quotes injected into odds features per scenario.

coherence_rules: 1X2 and each binary market sum to 1.
Team Over 1.5 probability does not exceed Over 0.5.

scenarios.STANDARD: Training-fold prior blended 50/50 with simple pre-match feature proxy.
scenarios.HEAVY_FAVOURITE: Synthetic quote assigns 78% to the stronger 1X2 side; binary markets assign 82% to the feature-proxy-favoured side.
scenarios.EXTREME_GAP: Synthetic quote assigns 93% to the stronger 1X2 side; binary markets assign 94% to the proxy-favoured side, creating longshot decimal prices.
scenarios.MISMATCHED_ODDS: Synthetic quote favours the side opposite the pre-match strength/goal proxy.

betting_style_rule.description: One hypothetical unit only when the largest model expected return at synthetic decimal odds is at least 3%.

limitations: Every test period in this project has already been reviewed; no untouched holdout.
The latest-season fold is partial and is for scenario stress screening only.
All odds are synthetic pre-match quotes, not bookmaker observations or live/in-play prices.
The production Mode B model was trained with historical closing-odds features; synthetic odds create distribution shift.
Hypothetical returns use invented prices and do not estimate real betting profit or readiness.
No live bet or money stake was placed; no production artifact was changed.
